contentText:
The Roku Ultra. | Image: Roku

Roku has increased prices across its streaming hardware, with the cheapest HD Streaming Stick now priced at $39.99 instead of $29.99, as first reported by The Desk . The price hike affects all of Roku's other devices as well, with some increasing by as much as $50. Here's a rundown of the changes:

- Streaming Stick : $29.99 to $39.99

- Streaming Stick Plus: $39.99 to $59.99

- Streaming Stick 4K : $49.99 to $79.99

- Roku Ultra: $99.99 to $149.99

- Roku Streambar SE : $99.99 to $149.99

Roku is currently holding a sale that puts some devices at their original prices, which you can see on this archived web page . Fox announced plans to acquire …
